claimBoundary.purpose: A product candidate responding to diagnostic failure patterns retained in v2, not to an eligible creator win.

budgetRevision.reason: Exact-HEAD review required quote-aware YAML comments and the then-reviewed metadata.hermes.config vendor surface.
budgetRevision.laterReason: A later exact-HEAD review required optional default_prompt, all-decodable-file local-path scanning, and single-line CommonMark reference-definition destinations.
budgetRevision.holisticReviewReason: A bounded exact-HEAD adversarial audit reduced the custom claim to a canonical ToolboxMD checker, made nested Hermes metadata opt-in, added quote-aware canonical scalar and Codex sidecar checks, exposed Markdown and non-Python-script coverage limits, and optionally invokes an already-installed official skills-ref validator.
budgetRevision.latestExactHeadReviewReason: Exact-HEAD review required YAML special-float classification and dot-relative fragile script-path detection.
budgetRevision.sequenceAndCommandReviewReason: Exact-HEAD review required active sequence-item state for canonical Hermes config and separator-bounded same-line fragile script detection.
budgetRevision.quoteOnlyCanonicalReason: Exact-HEAD review replaced partial implicit-YAML classification with JSON-double-quoted generated strings, mapping-only portable metadata, and parity-aware shell-continuation normalization.
budgetRevision.portableMetadataKeyReason: Exact-HEAD review required JSON-double-quoted user-defined portable metadata keys so YAML cannot implicitly type boolean, date, or numeric-looking keys.
budgetRevision.emptyMetadataReason: Exact-HEAD review required bare and comment-only metadata blocks to fail while omission remains valid.
budgetRevision.directCommandReason: Exact-HEAD review required command-position detection for direct task-relative helpers; the prescribed validator command now treats warnings as errors.
budgetRevision.optionalSidecarAndAssignmentReason: Exact-HEAD review aligned independently optional Codex sidecar sections and replaced library shell tokenization with a bounded readable lexical scanner preserving quote, escape, operator, redirection, comment, command-position, and assignment provenance.
budgetRevision.lexicalScannerCapRevisionReason: The 4,000-byte cap revision preserves readable activated-core doctrine and an executable-only bounded lexical scanner required by exact-HEAD review; activated-core, description, file, reference, eval, and script budgets are unchanged.
budgetRevision.groupingOperatorReason: Exact-HEAD review required unquoted shell grouping parentheses to create command boundaries while quoted and escaped parentheses remain word data; canonical inline Markdown links are masked before command scanning to preserve the existing link-destination false-positive boundary.
budgetRevision.scriptSyntaxAttestationReason: Exact-HEAD review required standalone unquoted shell grouping braces, without treating ordinary brace words as commands, and a no-execution, exact-digest operator attestation that lets separately checked non-Python helpers pass strict validation without claiming ToolboxMD ran their syntax commands.
budgetRevision.syntaxAttestationCapRevisionReason: The 4,000-byte cap revision preserves readable deterministic path, file-type, duplicate, and stale-digest diagnostics. Activated-core, description, file, reference, eval, and script budgets are unchanged, and no extra evidence artifact is required.
budgetRevision.shellControlPrefixReason: Exact-HEAD review required bounded same-line shell clause state for a fixed unquoted control-prefix set, preserving command position without treating quoted, escaped, prose, argument, fi, or done tokens as command boundaries.
budgetRevision.descriptionAngleBracketReason: Exact-HEAD review required built-in host-validator compatibility for descriptions containing angle brackets when the optional skills-ref executable is unavailable.
budgetRevision.closedSurfaceScriptPathReason: A Grok architecture audit and exact-HEAD review replaced the open-ended shell lexer with a closed-surface portability rule for root, blockquote, and list shell fences, single-line inline and other Markdown code contexts, UTF-8 helper sources, and executable or shebang files. A path-bearing child is an immediate non-whitespace lexical child after scripts/; leading-whitespace child names are outside this checker. The executable-only delta includes explicit context diagnostics and does not parse shell or full CommonMark grammar.

package.aggregateAlgorithm: SHA-256 of lines '<file-sha256>  <relative-path>\n' with entries sorted by bytewise UTF-8 relative path ascending

proves: the frozen product package and exact creator budgets reproduce
the validator runs from outside the package without Python bytecode writes

immediate non-whitespace task-relative helper children fail in root, blockquote, and list closed case-insensitive sh, bash, and shell fences without interpreting commands, strings, comments, heredocs, wrappers, assignments, or continuations

single-line inline code, indented code, and non-shell or unknown fences containing that lexical helper shape fail with a context error, while ordinary prose, Markdown link destinations, directory-only mentions, leading-whitespace child names, and explicit skill-directory paths remain accepted
all UTF-8 files below scripts/ and executable or shebang files reject task-relative helper paths, while generic configuration files remain outside this policy absent a schema
recognized shell fences must close and the prescribed validator command enables warnings-as-errors
explicit skill-directory script examples pass

the canonical current Codex sidecar subset handles quote-aware comments, duplicate fields, supported and bounded interface strings, assets-only icon paths, optional default_prompt, policy, and current tool dependencies
Codex interface, policy, and dependencies sections are independently optional; present sections must be nonempty and valid, while generated ToolboxMD sidecars retain nonempty UI fields
valid Markdown links with optional titles pass
single-line CommonMark reference-definition destinations support angle brackets and optional titles while missing and escaping targets fail
skill names containing reserved provider strings fail
name is the sole unquoted scalar while all other top-level strings require one-line JSON double quotes

the quote-only contract rejects plain prose, dates, hexadecimal, octal, collections, booleans, nulls, numbers, special floats, single quotes, block scalars, tags, nested scalar syntax, and invalid quotes without partial implicit-YAML classification
description angle brackets fail the built-in host-validator compatibility check even when skills-ref is unavailable, while ordinary quoted prose passes

portable metadata uses JSON-double-quoted user-defined keys and values with no sequence markers, while explicit Hermes mode keeps fixed schema fields unquoted and requires double-quoted user-provided values
bare and comment-only metadata blocks fail while omitting optional metadata passes
canonical Markdown links ignore code and escaped forms, validate simple destinations, and warn that complex or unresolved forms need official validation
common POSIX, container, file URI, and Windows workstation paths are detected, including shebangs
local paths in any UTF-8-decodable package file are detected, likely non-UTF-8 scripts fail, and binary assets are skipped

Python helper syntax is checked through AST while non-Python helpers require explicit exact-current-byte operator attestations to pass strict mode; the checker reports accepted paths and does not claim it executed their language-specific commands

an already-installed skills-ref is called without a shell using exact validate argv and a bounded timeout, with pass, invalid, unexpected, timeout, unavailable, and unattested external-behavior states reported separately
root-relative and remote web links are not misclassified as workstation paths
the real copyable minimal-skill example passes the canonical checker under an explicit package budget
default reference and eval baggage and unconditional Git inspection are absent
the retained meeting-followups and weekly-status-deck path and baggage patterns are detected
retained creator inputs remain byte-identical
doesNotProve: arbitrary YAML or full CommonMark validity
multiline inline code spans or task-relative helper child names whose first character is whitespace
shell command parsing or wrapper, assignment, quoting, comment, heredoc, continuation, and control-flow semantics
execution of language-specific checks or syntax validity of non-Python helper scripts
